verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic's Feed API lets merchants expose product catalog data to AI platforms (OpenAI, Meta), described as 'real-time catalog and inventory data' with live pricing. ACP/UCP checkout sessions return totals and fulfillment options. However, the data is pushed to platforms rather than documented as a directly readable offer endpoint for any developer. Missing for 10: documented direct read access to offer data by a developer, explicit variant fields, checkout-link fields, a published feed schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: Deliver a single product feed that automatically adapts to each AI platform's requirements, with accurate, real-time catalog and inventory data.
The mapped data is synchronized with AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta.
with live pricing, tax, and shipping synced at the point of selection
Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.
